283125207.description:
Natural Azurite & Malachite Specimen
Raw Mineral Display Rock
Natural Mineral, Approximately 5.5 Inches, 2.05 Pounds
This natural geological specimen showcases vibrant royal blue botryoidal azurite formations intergrown with rich green malachite across a dark gossan rock matrix. Azurite and malachite are secondary copper carbonate minerals prized for their intense coloration and contrasting visual texture. Specimens featuring intact crystal vugs and natural matrix presentation make exceptional display pieces for mineral collectors and natural history enthusiasts.
Features deep blue botryoidal azurite nodules and bright green malachite deposits
Solid natural matrix with exposed crystal vug on front face
Measures approximately 5.5 inches tall by 5 inches wide by 3 inches deep
Weight: approximately 2.05 pounds (2 lbs 1 oz)
Condition:
Natural rough mineral specimen in as-found unpolished condition. Crystal pockets show sharp natural formations and vibrant color with no visible artificial treatment or repair. Matrix is stable with typical natural fracturing and minor crumb shedding inherent to raw mineral rock.
